summary: If you haven’t chosen how to bill Copilot code review for members with a Copilot license, those reviews will be billed to your organization starting December 30, 2026. To keep billing unchanged, select Member before then.
takeaways: This change applies to organizations and enterprises with Copilot Business or Copilot Enterprise.
To learn more, see Configuring code review by GitHub Copilot .
